_about: Decisions applied on top of the source workbooks. The workbooks are never edited; delete or change an entry here and re-run the importer to undo it. Each entry records why.

rirAboveIsRpe.why: 15 rows in weeks 11 and 13 have 7 or 8 in the RIR column. Everything else in the program is RIR 0-1, and RIR 8 would be a warm-up. They are RPE values typed into the RIR column, so RIR = 10 - value (RPE 8 = RIR 2, RPE 7 = RIR 3).

fillSets.why: Supinated lat pulldown, week 7 Pull: no set count. Its superset partner and every other exercise in the session have 3.
Cable crunch, week 7 Legs & Abs: no set count. Every other exercise in the session has 3.

fillMissingRest.rule: Copy the rest from the same exercise in the same session in the nearest week; otherwise 2 min.
fillMissingRest.why: Two 18-week rows have no rest. Both exercises appear in other weeks with a rest given.

pairAsSuperset.why: Pump day: calf raise then plate shrug with 0 min rest. Week 7's pump day pairs a calf raise as C1 with a C2, and weeks 3 and 5 label the shrug C1 with no partner. Treated as calf raise + shrug superset in weeks 1, 3 and 5.

mainLiftRule.rule: Main lift if the exercise is a main lift in the library AND the program gives it 2+ min rest, or if the program gives anything 3+ min rest.
mainLiftRule.why: Rest alone mislabelled lifts like leg press at 1 min as accessories and missed none. The library knows which movements are big compound lifts; the rest time shows the role it plays in that session.

twelveWeekRotation.decision: Keep 5 sessions in odd weeks and 6 in even weeks, run as a rotation.
twelveWeekRotation.why: Squeezing six sessions into five would change your programming. On a rotation, a 6-session week just takes 8 or 9 days instead of 7; the scheduler shows this when you pick the program.

oneRepMaxVariations.decision: Accept: pin squat uses squat; pause bench, close-grip, Larsen and pin press use bench; block pulls, reset and opposite-stance deadlifts use deadlift.
oneRepMaxVariations.why: These are the percentages written in the sheet, which only make sense against the parent lift.

upperLowerNames.decision: Sessions named by position: Lower Body #1, Upper Body #1, Lower Body #2, Upper Body #2 in every week.
upperLowerNames.why: Weeks 6-8 repeat week 5 exactly; the 'Full Body' labels are copy-paste leftovers.

ambiguousNames._why: Names that could mean more than one exercise in the 18-week file, and how they were read. Change the alias in library_catalogue.py if any are wrong.
ambiguousNames.b stance db press: Standing dumbbell shoulder press, staggered (B) stance
ambiguousNames.pec flye (12-week): Cable fly (the note allows cables, bands or dumbbells)
